BiblicalUsage: Kolasis is punishment, penal infliction. Matthew 25:46 says the goats shall go away into everlasting punishment, but the righteous into life eternal, and 1 John 4:18 says fear hath torment, because perfect love casteth out fear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Matthew 25:46 and 1 John 4:18 are the two ends of the word: everlasting punishment for those who go away, and torment cast out by perfect love for those who stay.
